summary: Conditional scene-graph window-control query. First runs WindowControlTypeDetection(), then resolves a window control object from the global vtable dispatch root dword_7CD8C0 using a vtable method at offset 28 called with type argument 19. If the resolved control object is non-null, runs ObjectNameComparison() against this. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Call WindowControlTypeDetection() before resolving the control object.
Fetch the object pointer stored in the global dword_7CD8C0 and dispatch a __thiscall vtable method at offset 28 with (dword_7CD8C0, 19) to resolve the window control object.
Guard: only proceed when the resolved control object pointer v2 is non-null.
Call ObjectNameComparison(v2, this) comparing the resolved control object name with this when the object is non-null.

unresolved: Identity of the object rooted at global dword_7CD8C0 and the exact semantic of its vtable method at offset 28 are unknown.
Meaning of the type argument 19 and the target object of ObjectNameComparison depend on the window-control subsystem.
